description: This Java class 'PcChargeServices' provides payment processing services such as authorization, capture, release, and refund through a third-party payment gateway API. It handles credit card info setup, transaction requests, and response processing within the OFBiz framework.

classes.name: PcChargeServices
classes.description: A utility class providing payment transaction services such as authorization, capture, release, and refund via a third-party payment gateway API within the OFBiz framework.

methods.name: ccAuth
methods.description: Performs credit card authorization, sets transaction details, sends the request, and processes the response to determine success or failure.

methods.name: ccCapture
methods.description: Captures a previously authorized transaction using the transaction reference number.

methods.name: ccRelease
methods.description: Releases (voids) a pre-authorization transaction, if supported by configuration.

methods.name: ccRefund
methods.description: Refunds a captured transaction based on the reference number.

methods.name: setCreditCardInfo
methods.description: Populates the API with credit card details and billing address from the context.

methods.name: getApi
methods.description: Creates and configures the API object using provided properties.

methods.name: buildPccProperties
methods.description: Builds configuration properties for the payment gateway from entity properties.

methods.name: getAmountString
methods.description: Formats the transaction amount with proper scale and rounding for API submission.
